Primary Care Progress Note
Date: 07/18/2026
Patient: Kazuko Howe, 83 y.o. F

CC: Back pain

HPI: Back pain since 07/10/2026 after a fall from standing height. No radiation, no numbness or weakness reported. No bowel or bladder issues.

PE: Tenderness over lumbar paraspinals. No step-offs or deformities palpated. Neuro exam intact, strength 5/5 in lower extremities, sensation preserved.

Assessment: Acute back pain post-fall. No red flags.

Plan: Conservative mgmt with NSAIDs, activity modification, monitor symptoms. Follow-up prn or if worsening.

notes.title: Radiology Report
notes.author: Radiologist
notes.text:
Radiology Report
Date: 09/11/2026
Patient: Kazuko Howe, 83 y/o F

MRI 09/11/2026: T12 compression fx, marrow edema on STIR. ~38% T12 height loss. No other acute fractures identified. No paraspinal soft tissue mass or abnormal enhancement. Adjacent discs show mild degenerative changes without significant bulging or herniation. Spinal canal and neural foramina patent at all levels examined. No evidence of cord signal abnormality or edema. No suspicious osseous lesions noted.

Impression: T12 compression fracture with marrow edema consistent with acute/subacute injury. Recommend clinical correlation and follow-up as indicated.

Spine Intervention Consultation
Date: 09/17/2026
Patient: Kazuko Howe, 83 y/o F

HPI: Outpt, not admitted. NRS 8/10 despite 9 wks NSM (acetaminophen and calcitonin nasal spray, TLSO brace). Pain stable/slightly better. Pain at fx level; afebrile, no infx signs.

Plan: Referred for DEXA + osteoporosis program. Continue current NSM. Monitor symptoms closely; consider intervention if no improvement.
